# AteBit Tech — Retro & Vintage Computing Database
> Hand-curated directory of 763 retro and vintage computing resources — repair services, hardware vendors, YouTube channels, community forums, and more. Amiga to ZX Spectrum and beyond.

## Core Pages
- [Home / Directory](https://www.atebit.tech/): searchable, filterable directory of all 763 entries
- [Price Guide](https://www.atebit.tech/store/): find active eBay listings and asking prices
- [Classic Version](https://www.atebit.tech/classic/): plain HTML, works on vintage browsers
- [About](https://www.atebit.tech/about.html): project background and contact
- [Privacy](https://www.atebit.tech/privacy.html): hosting and analytics, Price Guide requests and eBay affiliate links, local theme storage, and contact email
- [Newsletter](https://atebittech.substack.com): Substack updates
